data.name: Namya
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Namya is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and art. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘namas’, meaning ‘to bow’ or ‘to offer obeisance’. The name signifies the act of seeking knowledge and offering respect to the divine source of wisdom.

Namya is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, evoking a sense of reverence and respect for the divine source of wisdom.
